If you want something fine line, ocean themed, or minimalist, come see us at Ace Tattooz Ghatkopar.

Every element of Mahadev, built into one composition.

Karan did this at our Ghatkopar studio in black and grey, and the detail in the metal shading on the trishul is what makes it look almost three dimensional.

If you have been carrying a Shiva tattoo idea and want every element to actually mean something, come talk to us at Ace Tattooz Ghatkopar, 90 Feet Road.

📞 8450999961

Trishul. Rudraksha. Tibetan Om. Shankh. Damru. Lotus. Each one chosen for its meaning, each one executed with the kind of detail that makes you look twice.

This is the kind of Mahadev tattoo people carry for life and not because it looks good. Because it means something that words cannot carry.

Custom Shiva tattoo designs at Ace Tattooz Ghatkopar, 90 Feet Road.
Har Har Mahadev.
📞 8450999961

Mahima Bhanushali did these matching daisy tattoos with green leaves and pink berry accents.

More floral designs:

Pink rose, blue rose, yellow sunflower, white daisies, green leaves, red berries. All on the calf. 

All done by Mahima Bhanushali in full colour.

This is what a colour floral tattoo looks like when the artist understands how to layer pigment so each flower reads distinctly without the whole composition turning into a blur.

See more floral work:

Red petals with sharp clean edges. 

The inside of the flower looks like someone painted a galaxy into it. 

Blue, yellow, green, purple, all bleeding into each other the way watercolour is supposed to.

Archana Nakhua Bhanushali has been doing this for 15 years and this watercolour lotus is one of the pieces clients reference most when they walk in.

Explore lotus designs:

A lotus at the crown of the spine. 

Mandala wings spreading across the entire upper back. 

Ornamental details that took real planning before a single line was drawn.

Mahima Bhanushali built this from scratch for a client who wanted something that filled the back without feeling heavy. It does the opposite. It looks like it belongs there.

Pet portrait tattoos are one of the most emotionally loaded requests we get. 

The client knows exactly what they want. The face has to be right. The expression has to be right. 

Everything else is secondary.
Karan Bhanushali got both right on this one. 

The Golden Retriever's expression, the softness of the fur, the way the botanical frame sits around the portrait without competing with it. 

Fine line rose, leaf work, botanical details. The whole composition feels like it belongs on that forearm.

Ace Tattooz Ghatkopar, 90 Feet Road.

Tennis is not just a sport for some people. 

It is the first thing they think about in the morning and the last thing they think about at night. This client wanted that feeling on their skin permanently.

Karan Bhanushali built this as a full abstract composition. The racket, the ball, the motion lines, the ink splashes. Nothing is static in this piece because the sport never is. 

The red accent thread running through it ties the whole thing together without overpowering the black and grey.

Custom sports tattoos at Ace Tattooz Ghatkopar, 90 Feet Road.

Om at the centre in red. Trishul geometry extending outward through the petal layers. Geometric border work wrapping the whole composition around the elbow. Every ring of the mandala has its own pattern and every pattern connects to the next one without a single line breaking the flow.

This is what a devotional mandala tattoo looks like when it is done with actual patience.

Why Do Tattoos Fade Over Time?

Many people expect a tattoo to look exactly the same forever, but some fading is completely normal. Even the best tattoos can lose some sharpness and vibrancy over the years.

One of the main reasons tattoos fade is sun exposure. UV rays can gradually break down tattoo pigments, making colors appear lighter. This is why many tattoo artists in Ghatkopar recommend using sunscreen on healed tattoos when spending time outdoors.

Skin naturally renews itself over time, which can also affect how a tattoo looks. Factors such as age, skin type, aftercare, and lifestyle habits all play a role in how well a tattoo ages.

The quality of the tattoo also matters a lot. Getting work done at a professional tattoo studio in Ghatkopar and following proper aftercare can help tattoos maintain their appearance for many years.

While some fading is unavoidable, good skincare and sun protection can significantly slow the process and keep tattoos looking their best.

Tattoo Pain Level Guide – Easy Understanding for First-Time Clients

Understanding tattoo pain helps you feel more prepared before your session. Here’s a simple guide based on common experience:

• Rib, spine, neck, fingers & feet → sensitive areas during tattooing
• Upper arm, shoulder & thigh → generally comfortable areas
• Forearm & calf → moderate sensation, usually easy to manage
• Pain level depends on body area, design size, and personal tolerance
• The sensation is temporary and changes throughout the session
• Staying relaxed and breathing steadily helps improve comfort
• Proper sleep and hydration before your appointment can make the process smoother
• At a professional tattoo studio in Ghatkopar, Mumbai, artists guide you throughout for a better experience

Every person feels it differently, but most clients find the process manageable and focus on the final result.

This is the kind of delicate work that takes a steady, experienced hand.
Fine line is one of our most requested styles at Ace Tattooz Colaba, and Karan is one of the artists who does it best.

📞 8450999943

Some devotional tattoos are a single symbol. This one is a whole world.

The trishul, the damru, the rudraksha, the lotus, the temple at the base. Karan built each element into a flowing forearm composition where everything connects. 

The black and grey shading gives the trishul a real metallic weight.
This is the kind of Mahadev piece that takes planning before the needle even touches skin. 

If that is what you are looking for, come see us at Ace Tattooz Colaba.

📞 8450999943

Some people pray with their hands. Some people carry their devotion on their skin.

Intentional. Built line by line at Ace Tattooz.

If you have been carrying a Shiva tattoo idea and have not found someone who understands the meaning behind every element, come talk to us at Ace Tattooz Colaba.
📞 8450999943

Matching wrist tattoos work when the execution is identical on both sides. 

These daisy wrist tattoos by Mahima Bhanushali are exactly that.

One flower, done twice, with no variation in petal shading, leaf placement or the tiny pink berry accents. If you are thinking about matching tattoos with someone, this is what the standard looks like.

📞 8450999943

Three different flowers, three different colours, one composition that holds together completely.

Mahima Bhanushali did this colour floral bouquet on the calf and every flower in it sits at a different depth.

The pink rose reads first, the blue rose second, the yellow sunflower anchors the bottom. That kind of layering does not happen by accident.

Red petals with sharp clean edges. 

The inside of the flower looks like someone painted a galaxy into it. 

Blue, yellow, green, purple, all bleeding into each other the way watercolour is supposed to.

Archana Nakhua Bhanushali has been doing this for 15 years and this watercolour lotus is one of the pieces clients reference most when they walk in.

Explore lotus designs:

Upper back tattoos are one of the most powerful placements you can choose. 

This ornamental lotus with mandala wings by Mahima Bhanushali is exactly why.

The lotus sits at the top of the spine in pink and blue. Everything else radiates outward from it in black and grey. Symmetrical, detailed, permanent.

Browse our lotus work:

Some people get a tattoo to remember someone they lost. Some get one to celebrate someone still very much here.

Either way, a pet portrait tattoo done well is one of the most personal pieces you can carry. 

Karan Bhanushali did this Golden Retriever portrait in fine line with a botanical frame. 

The face has the exact energy of a dog who is genuinely happy to see you. That is not easy to capture and it does not happen by accident.

Ace Tattooz Colaba, Pasta Lane.
📞 8450999943

A tattoo about your passion hits differently than any other kind.

This tennis tattoo by Karan Bhanushali is not a simple racket outline. 

It is a full composition built around movement, energy and what the sport actually feels like in your body when you are playing it. 

Abstract lines, ink splashes, a ball mid-flight, red thread running through the chaos.

Whatever your sport or passion is, we can build something around it that actually means something. 

Ace Tattooz Colaba, Pasta Lane.

Mahima built the Om in the centre, then the petal rings, then the trishul geometry cutting through the composition like an axis. 

The result is a tattoo that reads as spiritual and geometric at the same time without either element cancelling the other out.

Two sessions. One very patient client. One exceptionally detail-oriented artist.

If you have a mandala idea that is more specific than what you have seen elsewhere, come talk to us at Ace Tattooz Colaba.
